S.FORM: e, a, ira ku mi, e lituday tu, haci nu lusay,
S.PHON: ə a ira ku mi ə ɾituɬaj tu ħaʦi nu ɾusaj
S.FORM: e, a, ira ko mi, e litoday to, haci no losay,
S.PHON: ə a ira k[o|u] mi ə ɾit[o|u][ɬ|ɮ]aj t[o|u] ħaʦi n[o|u] ɾ[o|u]saj
S.TRANSL: 有一位去摘水果。
There was a person who was plucking fruit.

S.FORM: ta, sao'puen nuya, a wawa, kuya haci nu lusay, a pakalic i, kuliciw.
S.PHON: ta saoʡpuən nuja a wawa kuja ħaʦi nu ɾusaj a pakaɾiʦ i kuɾiʦiw
S.FORM: ta, sao'poen noya, a wawa, koya haci no losay, a pakalic i, koliciw.
S.PHON: ta sa[o|u]ʡp[o|u]ən n[o|u]ja a wawa k[o|u]ja ħaʦi n[o|u] ɾ[o|u]saj a pakaɾiʦ i k[o|u]ɾiʦiw
S.TRANSL: 後來，小孩子把水果集中，放置在腳踏車上。
Then, a child gathered the fruits and put them on the bike.

S.FORM: ta, dakawen nira a, minukay.
S.PHON: ta ɬakawən nira a minukaj
S.FORM: ta, dakawen nira a, minokay.
S.PHON: ta [ɬ|ɮ]akawən nira a min[o|u]kaj
S.TRANSL: 他騎著回家。
He rode home.

S.FORM: tangasa i fatad nu, lalan, mastul nu, ccay a, kuliciw, kuya wawa.
S.PHON: taŋasa i fataɬ nu ɾaɾan mastuɾ nu ʦʦaj a kuɾiʦiw kuja wawa
S.FORM: tangasa i fatad no, lalan, mastol no, ccay a, koliciw, koya wawa.
S.PHON: taŋasa i fata[ɬ|ɮ] n[o|u] ɾaɾan mast[o|u]ɾ n[o|u] ʦʦaj a k[o|u]ɾiʦiw k[o|u]ja wawa
S.TRANSL: 到一半的路程，小孩被另一部腳踏車撞倒。
On his way, another bike hit the child.

S.FORM: mapulin cingra, ta malaklak kuya, haci nu lusay.
S.PHON: mapuɾin ʦiŋra ta maɾakɾak kuja ħaʦi nu ɾusaj
S.FORM: mapolin cingra, ta malaklak koya, haci no losay.
S.PHON: map[o|u]ɾin ʦiŋra ta maɾakɾak k[o|u]ja ħaʦi n[o|u] ɾ[o|u]saj
S.TRANSL: 他跌倒，然後水果散落一地。
He fell down, and then the fruits were scattered all over.

S.FORM: maduka' ku, wa'ay ningra.
S.PHON: maɬukaʡ ku waʡaj niŋra
S.FORM: madoka' ko, wa'ay ningra.
S.PHON: ma[ɬ|ɮ][o|u]kaʡ k[o|u] waʡaj niŋra
S.TRANSL: 他的腳受傷。
His foot was wounded.

S.FORM: na nuya, malitmuh nu, tatuluay a, tamdaw cingra, ta, paluwadhantu cingra.
S.PHON: na nuja maɾitmuħ nu tatuɾuaj a tamɬaw ʦiŋra ta paɾuwaɬħantu ʦiŋra
S.FORM: na noya, malitmoh no, tatoloay a, tamdaw cingra, ta, palowadhanto cingra.
S.PHON: na n[o|u]ja maɾitm[o|u]ħ n[o|u] tat[o|u]ɾ[o|u]aj a tam[ɬ|ɮ]aw ʦiŋra ta paɾ[o|u]wa[ɬ|ɮ]ħant[o|u] ʦiŋra
S.TRANSL: 那個時候，有三個人與他交會，把他扶起來。
At that time, he met three people, who raised him to his feet.

S.FORM: ta padangentu nu, u tatuluay cingra ta, pakalicen i, kuliciw,
S.PHON: ta paɬaŋəntu nu u tatuɾuaj ʦiŋra ta pakaɾiʦən i kuɾiʦiw
S.FORM: ta padangento no, o tatoloay cingra ta, pakalicen i, koliciw,
S.PHON: ta pa[ɬ|ɮ]aŋənt[o|u] n[o|u] [o|u] tat[o|u]ɾ[o|u]aj ʦiŋra ta pakaɾiʦən i k[o|u]ɾiʦiw
S.TRANSL: 那三個人就幫忙他放上腳踏車。

TRANSL.notes: The three people helped him put (the fruits) on the bike.

S.TRANSL: The three people helped him put on the bike.

S.FORM: ta, rumakattu cingra,
S.PHON: ta rumakattu ʦiŋra
S.FORM: ta, romakatto cingra,
S.PHON: ta r[o|u]makatt[o|u] ʦiŋra
S.TRANSL: 然後他就開始走路了。
Then, he walked.

S.FORM: manga'aytu ku, rakat ningra.
S.PHON: maŋaʡajtu ku rakat niŋra
S.FORM: manga'ayto ko, rakat ningra.
S.PHON: maŋaʡajt[o|u] k[o|u] rakat niŋra
S.TRANSL: 他走的很順。
He walked smoothly.
